items.description: These methods are either MLLM with capabilities related to detection/localization, or multi-task models handling both OD/OVD and REC. Though they are not directly handling DOD and not evaluated on DOD benchmarks in their original papers, it is possible that they obtain a performance similar to the DOD baseline.
